create_distribution_from_config: create a Distribution object from a config object with num_tokens, num_loc, pattern_len, and pattern_cnt attributes
sample_distribution_patterns: sample n random patterns from a Distribution object using the sample method
generate_augmented_token_pairs: generate batches of augmented token embedding pairs using a Generator with a Distribution and batch size
compute_symbol_frequency: compute symbol frequency counts per location across all patterns in a Distribution using symbol_freq
create_mnist_generator: create an MNISTGenerator that yields reshaped multi-view MNIST image batches for self-supervised learning
